svg.title: Intervest Software Technologies
svg.desc: Intervest Software Technologies — Role: Full Stack Developer. Software Engineer - Intern (2022 - 2023). This internship solidified my understanding of full-stack development and industry best practices, enhancing my ability to deliver comprehensive software solutions with Springboot, Java, Javascript, SQL and Enonic CMS. Achievements: Contributed to the development of enterprise web applications; Gained hands-on experience with Spring Boot and Java backend development; Learned industry best practices for code organization and version control.
